About the project

A polished front end on a simple MVC foundation.

Fieldnotes is a portfolio-ready ASP.NET Core project that demonstrates controller routing, Razor-rendered pages, shared layouts, static assets, and environment-aware error handling.

01

What works now

Four complete sample essays, dedicated reading pages, live search and topic filters, responsive layouts, keyboard navigation, and a no-results state. Search also works without JavaScript in the MVC app.

02

How it is built

.NET 10 and ASP.NET Core MVC handle requests and routing. Controllers select Razor views, while a shared layout and one custom stylesheet create a consistent interface.

03

What comes next

Database persistence, an authoring workflow, authentication, and comments remain future work. The current articles are sample content stored in a typed C# catalog.
